commits.message: add reusable email templates
commits.body:
Add reusable email template support for CLI and interactive email composition.

- load templates from the NeoComposer config templates directory
- render subject and body placeholders from repeatable KEY=VALUE variables
- add template listing and template selection flows
- document template usage in README and generated docs
- include example HTML and Markdown templates
- create the templates directory during installation
commits.raw_message:
feat(templates): add reusable email templates

Add reusable email template support for CLI and interactive email composition.

- load templates from the NeoComposer config templates directory
- render subject and body placeholders from repeatable KEY=VALUE variables
- add template listing and template selection flows
- document template usage in README and generated docs
- include example HTML and Markdown templates
- create the templates directory during installation

commits.message:
fix(changelog): generate docs/changelog.json via direct git-cliff call

orhun/git-cliff-action always runs a second internal git-cliff invocation
appending --context to extract the version output. Passing --context
through our own args duplicated the flag on that internal call, which
errored and left docs/changelog.json unwritten (stuck at []). Call the
binary the first action step already downloaded directly instead of
routing through the action a second time.
commits.raw_message:
fix(changelog): generate docs/changelog.json via direct git-cliff call

orhun/git-cliff-action always runs a second internal git-cliff invocation
appending --context to extract the version output. Passing --context
through our own args duplicated the flag on that internal call, which
errored and left docs/changelog.json unwritten (stuck at []). Call the
binary the first action step already downloaded directly instead of
routing through the action a second time.
